We are sorry to read your comments, however we do not recognise this as a fair reflection of the care and professionalism consistently delivered by our team.

Our clinicians and reception staff work under significant demand to provide safe, timely, and appropriate care to all patients. The triage and digital systems you refer to are not “automation for its own sake,” but nationally recommended approaches designed to ensure patients are assessed based on clinical need and urgency.

All patients who contact the practice receive a clinical assessment, and where necessary are offered appropriate on the day appointments or advice. We strongly refute the suggestion that our team lacks compassion or willingness to listen—this is not consistent with patient feedback we routinely receive.

That said, we are always open to reviewing individual concerns. If you would like us to investigate your experience in detail, please contact the practice directly and ask to speak with the management team.

Regards,

Practice Management Team
Peel Hall Medical Practice

There are some doctors here who I've had issues with but I asked to speak with the Practice Manager to complain about it and she was lovely, listened to all my concerns and has put it on my records that I don't want to be seen by those doctors again.
I must say there are some great doctors here who do their job well and listen to you. Dr Greenslade and Dr Molyneux are the two I enjoy seeing. The male doctors have all been pleasant too. No issues with them at all.
On the flip side...
I (and friends who also attend this surgery) have found Dr Fazal didn't want to listen to concerns and wanted to get the appointment over as quick as possible. I found Dr Iram didn't listen and blamed my symptoms on my weight, telling me the symptoms will go when I've lost weight even though I have lost 50lbs and the symptoms have worsened since losing weight so her theory, I feel doesn't make sense.
(It's important that I include this in the review because anyone who is overweight will know how upsetting/irritating it is when you find a doctor who just blames everything on your weight.)

Overall the practice has some doctors who are great and some who I found just don't want to be there and will blame your symptoms on your weight.
All I can suggest is remember who you see, if you like them take note of their name and ask for them again.
